meta.name: minimalist-ui
meta.description: Clean editorial-style interfaces. Warm monochrome palette, typographic contrast, flat bento grids, muted pastels. No gradients, no heavy shadows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建干净、编辑风格的界面设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要简洁、温暖、无阴影的界面风格。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a clean, warm, shadowless interface style.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成极简、编辑风格的网页界面：暖色单色配色、高对比字体、扁平网格布局、柔和粉彩点缀，无渐变、无重阴影。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 编写前端代码（HTML、React、Tailwind、Vue）或设计布局时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个极简风格的着陆页，暖色调。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合该协议的 HTML/CSS 代码。

say.text: 用编辑风格做一个功能网格，包含三个卡片。
写一个 FAQ 手风琴组件，无框线设计。
say.note: Claude 会生成仅用底部边框分隔的简洁手风琴。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude generates clean, editorial-style web interfaces: warm monochrome palette, typographic contrast, flat bento grids, muted pastels, no gradients, no heavy shadows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to write frontend code (HTML, React, Tailwind, Vue) or design a layout.

say_en.text: Design a minimalist landing page with warm tones.
say_en.note: Claude will generate HTML/CSS following the protocol.

say_en.text: Create an editorial-style feature grid with three cards.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a bento grid with thin borders and subtle shadows.

say_en.text: Write a FAQ accordion component with no container boxes.
say_en.note: Claude generates a clean accordion separated only by bottom borders.
